questions.question: How did the Magna Carta influence modern democracies?
questions.solution_html:
• Magna Carta limited absolute monarchy -established the principle that rulers are subject
  • to law- inspiring modern democratic ideals such as due process, equality before law, and
  • protection of individual rights.
questions.final_answer: protection of individual rights
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How does NHRC contribute to strengthening democracy in India?
questions.solution_html:
• NHRC promotes democracy by ensuring government accountability- investigating human
  • rights violations, recommending reforms- spreading awareness on constitutional rights and
  • justice for marginalized communities.
questions.final_answer: justice for marginalized communities
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the composition and powers of the National Commission for Protection / of Child Rights (NCPCR).
questions.solution_html:

  • monitoring child rights violations- recommending reforms, and ensuring laws like POCSO
  • and RTE are effectively implemented.
questions.final_answer: and RTE are effectively implemented

questions.question: Analyse the significance of ethical journalism in safeguarding human rights?
questions.solution_html:
• Ethical journalism protects human rights by promoting truth accountability, and
  • transparency-exposes abuses, prevents misinformation, and ensures the media acts as a
  • watchdog for democracy and justice.
questions.final_answer: watchdog for democracy and justice
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the role of rehabilitation and vocational training in improving the lives of / prisoners.
questions.solution_html:
• Rehabilitation and vocational training reform prisoners- providing skills, education, and
  • psychological support-reducing recidivism, and preparing them for reintegration as
  • productive, law-abiding members of society.
questions.final_answer: productive, law-abiding members of society
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Why is Ram Mohan Roy considered a pioneer of human rights in India?
questions.solution_html:
• Ram Mohan Roy pioneered human rights by challenging social evils like sati- promoting
  • freedom of speech, women’s rights, education, and rationalism- laying the foundation for
  • modern reform movements in India.
questions.final_answer: modern reform movements in India
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the scope of judicial review in India?
questions.solution_html:
• Judicial review allows courts to examine the constitutionality of laws and executive
  • actions, ensuring they align with the Constitution -protecting citizens’ rights from arbitrary
  • or unlawful government actions.
questions.final_answer: or unlawful government actions
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyze the obstacles that prevent persons with disabilities from accessing / education and employment opportunities in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Persons with disabilities face barriers such as inaccessible infrastructure, social stigma
  • lack of inclusive education, and inadequate job opportunities- preventing their full
  • participation in education and employment sectors.
questions.final_answer: participation in education and employment sectors
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of HRLN’s litigation and advocacy in influencing / policy reforms on human rights issues.
questions.solution_html:
• Human Rights Law Network (HRLN) has been highly effective in influencing policy
  • reforms on human rights issues in India through a combination of strategic public interest
  • litigation (PIL), legal aid, and integrated advocacy-HRLN’s strategic litigation and advocacy
  • have influenced policy reforms by challenging human rights violations in courts, ensuring
  • justice for vulnerable groups- pressing governments to implement rights-based policies.
questions.final_answer: justice for vulnerable groups- pressing governments to implement rights-based policies
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How does bulldozer justice conflict with the rule of law?
questions.solution_html:
• Bulldozer justice violates the rule of law by bypassing legal procedures, denying fair
  • hearings, and promoting arbitrary state action, undermining judicial authority, due process
  • and citizens’ constitutional rights.
questions.final_answer: and citizens’ constitutional rights
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyse the impact of the UDHR on international human rights movements.
questions.solution_html:
• UDHR profoundly influenced international human rights movements by establishing a
  • universal framework for dignity, equality, and freedom-inspired global treaties, national
  • constitutions, and activism- leading to institutions and norms that protect individuals from
  • state abuse and promote justice worldwide.
questions.final_answer: state abuse and promote justice worldwide
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Compare the Right to Equality and the Right to Freedom. Examine its relevance / in creating a democratic polity in India.
questions.solution_html:
• Right to Equality ensures equal treatment before law, while the Right to Freedom
  • guarantees expression, movement, and association-together, they empower citizens, prevent
  • discrimination, and enable participation in governance- forming the moral and legal
  • foundation of India’s democratic and inclusive political system.
questions.final_answer: foundation of India’s democratic and inclusive political system
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the significance of the Vishaka Guidelines and the POSH Act in / promoting a safe and harassment-free workplace for women in India
questions.solution_html:
• Vishaka Guidelines (1997) and the POSH Act (2013) defined and criminalized workplace
  • sexual harassment- making employers responsible for prevention and redressal-they
  • institutionalized gender-sensitive mechanisms- empowering women to work safely and
  • promoting equality, dignity, and justice within India’s professional and social spaces.
questions.final_answer: promoting equality, dignity, and justice within India’s professional and social spaces
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine Right to Privacy as an essential component of human rights and / evaluate its significance in safeguarding individual freedom
questions.solution_html:
• Right to Privacy- upheld in the Puttaswamy judgment (2017)- vital to human dignity and
  • autonomy-safeguards individuals from state surveillance, data misuse, and intrusion
  • ensuring personal liberty, freedom of choice, democratic accountability—core components of
  • modern human rights protection.
questions.final_answer: modern human rights protection
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain the concept of judicial review and its constitutional basis in India. Discuss its / significance in maintaining the rule of law and protecting fundamental rights.”
questions.solution_html:
• Judicial review is the power of the judiciary to examine the constitutional validity of laws
  • and executive actions- basis lies in Articles 13, 32, 131–136, 226, and 227 of the Indian
  • Constitution-upholds the Constitution- protects Fundamental Rights and ensures the rule of
  • law by preventing arbitrary use of power- - constitutional supremacy - protection of rights
  • checks and balances.
questions.final_answer: checks and balances
questions.source_exam: III Semester MGU-UGP-(Hons) 2024 Admission Regular(Special Examination) Examination July 2026

  • development.

  • against misuse, ensuring proportionality, data protection, and limited mandatory use - right
  • to privacy - data protection - constitutional safeguards.
questions.final_answer: to privacy - data protection - constitutional safeguards
